points.description: Names 'run-of-river plant' (run-of-river hydropower plant) as a type.
Names 'storage plant' (storage/reservoir hydropower plant) as a type.
Names 'cascade plant' (plants in series along a river) as a type.
Names 'pumped storage plant' as a type.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all four types named with the correct technical terms: run-of-river, storage, cascade, pumped storage. Each type is worth 0.5; vague descriptions without the proper name earn nothing for that item. Any wrong extra type (e.g. a type based on head, such as low-head or high-head) costs one of the earned points. Total is 2 marks, so round any fractional total down to a whole mark only if the marker's sheet requires it.
